name: Yuukyuu Gensoukyouku 2nd Album
source:
The Third Division Vigilante Corps have earned the trust of the people of Enfield, and under the popular Commander Neumann, they have worked hard to earn this trust. However, Neumann is now gone, leaving the third division with low morale and little work, and eventually the main character from the previous game is the only member left. The third division is to be disbanded, but he appeals to the director, and is given one year to restore the third division to its former glory.

Yuukyuu Gensoukyouku 2nd Album follows directly after the events of the first game, and is once more a traditional Japanese adventure game. You must gather your group to perform jobs for the people of Enfield, and interact with the various characters around town.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/yky-genskyoku-2nd-album]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
自警團第三部隊贏得了恩菲爾德居民的信賴。在深受愛戴的諾伊曼隊長帶領下，隊員們為爭取這份信賴付出了許多努力。然而，如今諾伊曼已不在人世，第三部隊士氣低落，工作寥寥，最終只剩下前作的主角一人。第三部隊即將解散，但他向團長提出請求，獲准用一年的時間讓第三部隊重現昔日的榮光。

《悠久幻想曲2nd Album》的劇情緊接前作，同樣是一款傳統的日式冒險遊戲。你需要召集夥伴，為恩菲爾德的居民完成各項工作，並與鎮上的不同人物交流。

[編譯自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/yky-genskyoku-2nd-album]MobyGames[/url]]
